task_label: Implement hidden routine candidate lifecycle and fail-closed guards
acceptance_criteria: One qualifying successful multi-step workflow creates exactly one internal routine candidate instead of a visible saved routine.
Risky, sensitive, or strongly context-dependent workflows do not create a candidate in v1.
An unconfirmed candidate expires after 30 days and is no longer treated as active.
task_prompt: Implement TASK-SPEC29.1 only. Add the hidden candidate lifecycle for silent routine learning in v1. After one qualifying successful multi-step workflow, Janus should create exactly one internal candidate rather than a visible saved routine. Risky, sensitive, or strongly context-dependent workflows must fail closed and create no candidate. Unconfirmed candidates must expire after 30 days and no longer count as active learning candidates. Keep the slice strictly backend/persistence-only. Do not add automatic promotion, passive chat hints, settings UI, routines API, OAuth, transport changes, commits, dependencies, or broader architecture changes. Return concise JSON-compatible output with status, root_cause, changed_files, command_results, summary, and blockers.
